title: Intake: seedBacklog mints an implementation-plan ticket carrying the captured problem/goals/scope
description:
From the 2026-07-18 intake+KB-graph design review (report: scratchpad/intake-and-kb-graph-review.md, Q1 Option 1 — the highest-value gap). The discovery-first intake epic (TASK-045..048) captures problem_statement/goals/scope_in/scope_out and renders them into PROJECT.md + project-context.md, but src/backlog-seeder.js (seedBacklog) mints tickets purely from answers.primary_use_cases against fixed catalogs (src/backlog-seeder.js:1-100) and NEVER reads the definition prose — the richest data the wizard collects has no backlog consumer.

HUMAN SCOPE DECISION (2026-07-18): the mint-a-plan approach, NOT filter/reword and NOT generate-from-prose. seedBacklog additionally mints exactly ONE 'Draft an implementation plan against the stated goals/scope' ticket whose description carries problem_statement verbatim and whose ACs reference the stated goals/scope_in. The prose is passed through VERBATIM — no LLM generation — so the seeder stays deterministic and fixture-testable.
acceptance_criteria: When the captured definition is non-empty (problem_statement and/or goals/scope_in/scope_out), seedBacklog mints exactly one additional 'implementation plan' ticket whose description contains the problem_statement verbatim and whose acceptance_criteria reference the stated goals/scope_in.
When the entire definition is empty (no problem_statement, goals, scope_in, scope_out), NO plan ticket is minted (back-compat with definition-less inits).
The plan ticket is deterministic: identical answers produce a byte-identical ticket body (no generated or nondeterministic content) — proven by a fixture-based spec.
Existing primary_use_cases-driven seeding is unchanged and existing backlog-seeder specs stay green.

comments.body: CLOSED (autonomous loop, auto_close_on_green_review) — clean first-pass APPROVE (0 HIGH / 1 procedural MEDIUM / 2 LOW / 1 NIT). review_depth: FULL (rubric inputs: 399 insertions / 3 deletions across 3 files; forced full by >150 changed lines + packaging/dist [dist/init.cjs rebuilt] + ticket-minting logic). tdd single-commit. Fix: seedBacklog (src/backlog-seeder.js) Step 5 mints exactly ONE 'Draft an implementation plan against the stated goals/scope' ticket (verification_tier uat-only) when the captured definition is non-empty, embedding problem_statement VERBATIM and folding goals/scope_in into its acceptance_criteria; mints nothing when the whole definition is empty (back-compat). New normalizeDefinitionList + buildPlanTemplate; mintTicket now forwards verification_tier (omitted when undefined, so existing COMMON/USE_CASE tickets are byte-unchanged — reviewer traced createTask spread at src/task-store.js:664). tdd red-run CREDIBLE: reviewer independently reproduced 4/6 assertion-level failures for the right reason at d62938f~1 (plan ticket not minted / not additive). Gates green: fast tier 996/2, backlog-seeder + init-command + use-case-suite e2e all green (run directly — TASK-109 dynamic-import blind spot), dist-parity 8 bundles byte-match, calibration clean. Procedural MEDIUM (non-blocking): developer's R3 checklist reached the orchestrator but was not forwarded into the reviewer briefing — all five items independently verified green. LOW follow-ups (to batch at epic end): (1) mintTicket docblock 'body MUST contain the tag substring' invariant now contradicts the plan tag's body — scope the invariant to common/use-case tags; (2) whitespace-only problem_statement mints nothing correctly but is unlocked by spec, and the '(none captured)' placeholder branch tests .length>0 not .trim().length>0 (cosmetic).
